summary: # Request Mocking Intercept, mock, modify, and block network requests. ## CLI Route Commands ```bash # Mock with custom status playwright-cli route "**/*.jpg" --status=404 # Mock with JSON body playwright-cli route "**/api/users" --body='[{"id":1,"name":"Alice"}]' --content-type=application/json # Mock with custom headers playwright-cli route "**/api/data" --body='{"ok":true}' --header="X-Custom: value"
